verdict.rationale: The docs show several ways to act on many items at once. Traces can be filtered and exported via the UI or API, and rules, webhooks and online evaluators run automatically across production traces using filters and sampling. Experiments also run an application over a whole dataset with configurable concurrency. None of the evidence describes explicit bulk actions such as multi-select edit, delete, tag or move. missing for 10: explicit bulk select/edit/delete operations on traces or dataset examples, documented bulk API endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
